notes.title: StarRabbits Officially released.
notes.notes: [p]We encountered many difficulties before the official release of our game.[/p][p]However, we have completed the development of the essential game mode for the official release [/p][p]of this game.[/p][list][*][p]story (stagemode clear / challenage mode clear)[/p][/*][*][p]infinite mode[/p][/*][*][p]Game fixed bug and polishing[/p][/*][/list][p]We are finally ready to officially launch it.[/p][p]And we will continue to make gradual updates to improve the quality of the game. However, this process will be slow because  I'm a solo game developer.[/p][p]We are very grateful for your love for our game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you. See you again soon![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Look up your ID on the credit.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43482638/6edd7afa624269cd8c207d606a93218bc8e45ecb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43482638/ecc7c550e7054b598aa54d7d22a1c98957d8ba23.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43482638/f95276e08c2423213d9be48793ac3b31b1749e76.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [ Update Demo ] Add Boot Camp of Star Rabbits
notes.notes:
Introduce Star Rabbits Boot Camp!
Boot camps will make it easier for you to enjoy games.

We put a lot of experience into the player's hands with simple controls.
To allow for multiple playthroughs, obstacles, and enemies are generated with Random for each stage.
